A positive affective analysis also has a true truth-apt evil-utterance witness. Rejected inference from positive expressive meaning alone to no truth; rejected inference from ¬Holds to true opposite moral judgment, no actual suffering, all problems of evil moot, or God established. Full exact scopes and remaining bridges are in docs/notes/evil-emotivism-use-boundary.md. The four-bridge result excludes only the selected utterance as the critic's own true premise under those same semantics; it does not remove descriptive suffering or demand an independently grounded moral theory from an internal critic. Existing affective and internal-survivor controls are reused. The audit also rejects immediate God-from-objective-evil inference and treats the naturalistic-realist grounding comparison as substantive rather than automatically false. This is analyst prose and provisional warrant assessment, not a new checked result or source attribution; fresh independent review remains required.

2026-11-17 coordinator integration: fresh independent semantic challenge of the actual dated continuation and coordinator conclusions found no substantive defects; no repair round was required. This supersedes pending-review work-status wording for this owner reply. Existing formal evidence is reused, not freshly certified; no premise establishment or rival defeat beyond the stated scopes.
